rationale: Read all thirteen sections, provenance table, chunk/split code and five ingestion frames. Whole-document/structured retrieval are possible; this design uses chunks. Immutable/versioned URLs can identify exact text, while metadata needs an authorized retained resolver. Real retrieval can be deterministic. Chunk seams/headings can affect evidence without making all answers impossible; neighboring context may help. Group correlated support without dropping all same-source spans. Retained superseded versions follow explicit current/historical access/retention policies. Source revision→ingestion difference alone cannot prove current index lag. HTTP validators help conditional fetch, not preservation. Pipeline metadata must itself be trusted; no guaranteed one-minute diagnosis or negligible storage cost.
